profile.name: Chris Selig, MBA
profile.headline: Senior Data Engineer, Analytics
profile.summary: Senior data and analytics professional who builds pipelines, dashboards, and automation that turn chaos into clarity. Brings strong hands-on expertise in Python, SQL, Databricks, Spark, Power BI, and R, along with a practical, business-focused approach to solving real problems. Experienced in translating complex data into reliable, high-value solutions that save time, improve decisions, and quietly retire a few terrible spreadsheets along the way.

Data Science.accomplishment: Built a k-means customer-segmentation model in R to group branch customers for targeted strategy.
Developed a time series algorithm in R to forecast IT financial costs more efficiently than the traditional process.

Business Intelligence.accomplishment: Led the Power BI implementation program rolled out across the entire business, including training users on best practices.
Created a Power BI dashboard for HR to visualize executives' goals and track progress.

Visual Analytics.accomplishment: Built Spotfire reports (with HTML/CSS) tracking project-portfolio costs and status for upper management and the CIO — the first time all costs were visualized together.
Built a 165-query Power BI report that automated data ingestion into a dashboard for my clients' clients.

Data Engineering.accomplishment: Developed a SQL Server database as the single source of truth for the Planning and Controls team, cutting reporting time dramatically.
Built and maintained the entire HR data model using Python, PySpark, and Databricks.

Data Analysis.accomplishment: Built an R-based analysis that quantified data-submission errors for the first time, focusing training initiatives.
Ran advanced statistical text mining (topic modeling, word sentiment, bigrams) on an IT Engagement survey, providing an action plan for IT leadership.

Automation.accomplishment: Developed an AI-based model that reads different file formats and extracts the data into tables — saving end users 4 days of work each time new files were sent.
Built a Power Automate flow using AI to extract information from PDF files, saving 10 hours a month.
